name: ZooTeens Teen Volunteer Program
org: The Living Desert Zoo and Gardens
what_you_do: Volunteer at the zoo two shifts a month and go to monthly meetings. Year one covers animals, conservation and guest service. Later years add projects, leadership, and career help.
who_can_apply: Teens 14 to 18 years old by June 1. No experience needed. You must be friendly and professional with guests.
duration: Two shifts a month and monthly meetings; a 4-year program, and you can serve one year or all four
deadline_text: The page says it is taking applications for Spring 2027. No deadline is posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the ZooTeen application online (link on the page), then go to orientation. Phone: 760-346-5694.
notes: Requires attending ZooTeen orientation. Address: 47900 Portola Avenue, Palm Desert, CA 92260.
